parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `MetadataMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift`. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Additionally, the two types differ in a semantically meaningful way: `responses` is typed `[Data]` in the Artwork mock (an ordered sequence of responses) versus `responses:[String: Data]` in the Metadata mock (a keyed dictionary), reflecting genuinely different stubbing strategies for their respective test scenarios. Merging or genericising these fixtures would couple unrelated test packages and obscure the intent of each stub.
